item.title: Brand Identity Design
item.description: A complete brand identity design project for a technology startup, including logo design, color palette, typography, and brand guidelines. Project Brief Create a modern, professional brand identity that communicates innovation, reliability, and approachability for a B2B software company. Brand Strategy The brand strategy focused on positioning the company as a trusted technology partner that simplifies complex business processes.
